articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Shareholder Activism Puts GE Israel Defense Contracts And ESG Risks In Focus. JLens and the Anti Defamation League are urging GE Aerospace shareholders to vote against a proposal at the upcoming annual meeting. The proposal asks NYSE:GE to commission an independent report on its human rights and international law due diligence for products supplied to Israel's defense sector.
